```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Helper: load required packages safely and fail with a clear message
load_required_packages <- function(pkgs) {
  missing_pkgs <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

  if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "The following required packages are not installed: ",
        paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", ")
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  invisible(lapply(pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE))
}
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Helper to load .qs files into .GlobalEnv
make_unique_name <- function(name, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  if (!exists(name, envir = envir, inherits = FALSE)) {
    return(name)
  }

  i <- 1L
  repeat {
    candidate <- paste0(name, "_", i)
    if (!exists(candidate, envir = envir, inherits = FALSE)) {
      return(candidate)
    }
    i <- i + 1L
  }
}

load_qs_file <- function(file_path, root_dir = project_dir, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  full_path <- file.path(root_dir, file_path)

  if (!file.exists(full_path)) {
    stop(sprintf("Required file does not exist: %s", full_path), call. = FALSE)
  }

  var_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  var_name <- make_unique_name(var_name, envir = envir)

  obj <- qs::qread(full_path)
  assign(var_name, obj, envir = envir)

  invisible(var_name)
}
```

# Pre-processing

## Re-naming

```{r}
# Analysis constants
baseline_date <- as.Date("2018-04-01")

# Generic helper for vaccine-at-baseline objects
make_baseline_vacc_df <- function(data, date_cols, firstdate_name, indicator_name, cutoff_date = baseline_date) {
  data %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      "{firstdate_name}" := {
        vals <- c_across(all_of(date_cols))
        vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
        if (length(vals) == 0) as.Date(NA) else min(vals)
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      "{indicator_name}" := dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(.data[[firstdate_name]]) & .data[[firstdate_name]] <= cutoff_date,
        1L, 0L
      )
    )
}


# Standard helper for public/private event objects
rename_event_df <- function(data, source_prefix, target_prefix, firstdate_source = paste0(source_prefix, "_1")) {
  counts_col     <- paste0(source_prefix, "_counts")
  counts_bl_col  <- paste0(source_prefix, "_counts_at_baseline")
  counts_1yp_col <- paste0(source_prefix, "_counts_1_year_pre")

  needed <- c("new_enc_nhi", counts_col, counts_bl_col, counts_1yp_col, firstdate_source)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(needed, names(data))

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "rename_event_df() missing expected columns for",
        target_prefix, ":",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  data %>%
    rename(
      !!paste0(target_prefix, "_counts") := all_of(counts_col),
      !!paste0(target_prefix, "_counts_at_bl") := all_of(counts_bl_col),
      !!paste0(target_prefix, "_counts_1yp") := all_of(counts_1yp_col),
      !!paste0(target_prefix, "_firstdate") := all_of(firstdate_source)
    ) %>%
    select(
      new_enc_nhi,
      all_of(paste0(target_prefix, "_counts")),
      all_of(paste0(target_prefix, "_counts_at_bl")),
      all_of(paste0(target_prefix, "_counts_1yp")),
      all_of(paste0(target_prefix, "_firstdate"))
    )
}

# Simpler helper for drug objects
rename_drug_df <- function(data, source_prefix, target_prefix, firstdate_source = NULL) {
  counts_col     <- paste0(source_prefix, "_counts")
  counts_bl_col  <- paste0(source_prefix, "_counts_at_baseline")
  counts_1yp_col <- paste0(source_prefix, "_counts_1_year_pre")

  needed <- c("new_enc_nhi", counts_col, counts_bl_col, counts_1yp_col)
  if (!is.null(firstdate_source)) {
    needed <- c(needed, firstdate_source)
  }

  missing_cols <- setdiff(needed, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "rename_drug_df() missing expected columns for",
        target_prefix, ":",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  out <- data %>%
    rename(
      !!paste0(target_prefix, "_counts") := all_of(counts_col),
      !!paste0(target_prefix, "_counts_at_bl") := all_of(counts_bl_col),
      !!paste0(target_prefix, "_counts_1yp") := all_of(counts_1yp_col)
    )

  if (!is.null(firstdate_source)) {
    out <- out %>%
      rename(
        !!paste0(target_prefix, "_firstdate") := all_of(firstdate_source)
      ) %>%
      select(
        new_enc_nhi,
        all_of(paste0(target_prefix, "_counts")),
        all_of(paste0(target_prefix, "_counts_at_bl")),
        all_of(paste0(target_prefix, "_counts_1yp")),
        all_of(paste0(target_prefix, "_firstdate"))
      )
  } else {
    out <- out %>%
      select(
        new_enc_nhi,
        all_of(paste0(target_prefix, "_counts")),
        all_of(paste0(target_prefix, "_counts_at_bl")),
        all_of(paste0(target_prefix, "_counts_1yp"))
      )
  }

  out
}

zoster_binflag <- immunisation_counts %>%
  mutate(
    hz_vacc = as.integer(rZV > 0 | old_rZV > 0),
    pcv_vacc = as.integer(PCV13 > 0),
    influenza_vacc = as.integer(Influenza > 0),
    total_counts_influenza_vacc = Influenza,
    ppv_vacc = as.integer(`23PPV` > 0)
  ) %>%
  select(
    new_enc_nhi,
    hz_vacc,
    pcv_vacc,
    influenza_vacc,
    total_counts_influenza_vacc,
    ppv_vacc
  )

hz_vacc_df_at_bl <- rZV %>%
  full_join(old_rZV, by = "new_enc_nhi") %>%
  make_baseline_vacc_df(
    date_cols = c(paste0("rZV_", 1:6), paste0("old_rZV_", 1:16)),
    firstdate_name = "hz_vacc_firstdate",
    indicator_name = "hz_vacc_at_bl"
  )


PCV13_df_at_bl <- PCV13 %>%
  make_baseline_vacc_df(
    date_cols = paste0("PCV13_", 1:7),
    firstdate_name = "PCV13_firstdate",
    indicator_name = "PCV13_at_bl"
  )

PPV23_df_at_bl <- `23PPV` %>%
  make_baseline_vacc_df(
    date_cols = paste0("23PPV_", 1:5),
    firstdate_name = "PPV23_firstdate",
    indicator_name = "PPV23_at_bl"
  )

influenza_vacc_df_at_bl <- Influenza %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -new_enc_nhi,
    names_to = "Influenza_var",
    values_to = "date"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date), date <= baseline_date) %>%
  group_by(new_enc_nhi) %>%
  summarise(
    influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl = sum(!is.na(date)),
    influenza_vacc_first_date = min(date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    influenza_vacc_at_bl = as.integer(influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl > 0)
  )
```

```{r}
## Merging

# -----------------------------
# Helper functions
# -----------------------------

assert_unique_key <- function(data, data_name, key = "new_enc_nhi") {
  if (!key %in% names(data)) {
    stop(sprintf("Key column '%s' is missing in '%s'.", key, data_name), call. = FALSE)
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(data[[key]]) > 0) {
    stop(
      sprintf("'%s' contains duplicate '%s' values and would create row multiplication in left_join().", data_name, key),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

safe_left_join <- function(x, y) {
  dplyr::left_join(x, y, by = "new_enc_nhi")
}

replace_na0 <- function(x) {
  tidyr::replace_na(x, 0)
}

first_nonmissing_date <- function(...) {
  out <- pmin(..., na.rm = TRUE)
  out[is.infinite(out)] <- as.Date(NA)
  out
}

row_sum0 <- function(...) {
  rowSums(cbind(...), na.rm = TRUE)
}

assert_unique_key(cohort, "cohort")
purrr::iwalk(join_inputs, ~ assert_unique_key(.x, .y))

# Perform all joins
combined <- purrr::reduce(join_inputs, safe_left_join, .init = cohort) %>%
  mutate(
    # Replace NA with 0 for all count variables
    across(matches("(_counts$|_counts_at_bl$|_counts_1yp$)"), replace_na0),

    # Vaccinations at baseline
    hz_vacc_at_bl = replace_na0(hz_vacc_at_bl),
    PCV13_at_bl = replace_na0(PCV13_at_bl),
    PPV23_at_bl = replace_na0(PPV23_at_bl),
    influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl = replace_na0(influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl),
    influenza_vacc_at_bl = replace_na0(influenza_vacc_at_bl),

    # First dates
    first_dementia_overall = first_nonmissing_date(pub_dementia_firstdate, pri_dementia_firstdate, drug_dementia_firstdate),
    first_hz_vacc_overall = hz_vacc_firstdate,
    first_zoster_overall = first_nonmissing_date(pub_zoster_firstdate, pri_zoster_firstdate, drug_zoster_firstdate),
    first_viral_overall = first_nonmissing_date(pub_viral_infection_firstdate, pri_viral_infection_firstdate),
    first_bacterial_overall = first_nonmissing_date(pub_bacterial_infection_firstdate, pri_bacterial_infection_firstdate),
    first_other_infections_overall = first_nonmissing_date(pub_other_infections_firstdate, pri_other_infections_firstdate),

    # Short aliases kept for downstream compatibility
    pub_viral_counts = pub_viral_infection_counts,
    pri_viral_counts = pri_viral_infection_counts,
    pub_viral_counts_at_bl = pub_viral_infection_counts_at_bl,

    dru_aspirin_counts_1yp = drug_aspirin_counts_1yp,

    dru_statins_counts = drug_statins_counts,

    dru_statins_counts_1yp = drug_statins_counts_1yp,
```

```{r}
# Merge combined data with zoster binary flag and combined dementia data

# -----------------------------
# Analysis constants
# -----------------------------
follow_up_beg_date <- as.Date("2018-04-01")
follow_up_end_date <- as.Date("2023-06-30")
cutoff_date_const  <- as.Date("1937-04-02")

# -----------------------------
# Helper
# -----------------------------
replace_na0 <- function(x) dplyr::coalesce(x, 0)

data <- combined %>%
  left_join(zoster_binflag, by = "new_enc_nhi") %>%
  filter(GENDER %in% c("F", "M")) %>%
  mutate(
    # ---------------------------------
    # Vaccination variables
    # ---------------------------------
    across(
      c(
        hz_vacc, pcv_vacc, influenza_vacc, total_counts_influenza_vacc, ppv_vacc,
        hz_vacc_at_bl, PCV13_at_bl, PPV23_at_bl, influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl, influenza_vacc_at_bl
      ),
      replace_na0
    ),

    # ---------------------------------
    # Drug aliases retained for downstream compatibility
    # ---------------------------------
    dru_macrolides_counts = replace_na0(drug_macrolides_counts),
    dru_other_antibiotics_counts = replace_na0(drug_other_antibiotics_counts),
    dru_penicillins_counts = replace_na0(drug_penicillins_counts),
    dru_tetracyclines_counts = replace_na0(drug_tetracyclines_counts),
    dru_ceph_counts = replace_na0(drug_ceph_counts),

    dru_macrolides_counts_at_bl = replace_na0(drug_macrolides_counts_at_bl),
    dru_other_antibiotics_counts_at_bl = replace_na0(drug_other_antibiotics_counts_at_bl),
    dru_penicillins_counts_at_bl = replace_na0(drug_penicillins_counts_at_bl),
    dru_tetracyclines_counts_at_bl = replace_na0(drug_tetracyclines_counts_at_bl),
    dru_ceph_counts_at_bl = replace_na0(drug_ceph_counts_at_bl),

    dru_macrolides_counts_1yp = replace_na0(drug_macrolides_counts_1yp),
    dru_other_antibiotics_counts_1yp = replace_na0(drug_other_antibiotics_counts_1yp),
    dru_penicillins_counts_1yp = replace_na0(drug_penicillins_counts_1yp),
    dru_tetracyclines_counts_1yp = replace_na0(drug_tetracyclines_counts_1yp),
    dru_ceph_counts_1yp = replace_na0(drug_ceph_counts_1yp),

    # ---------------------------------
    # Fill missing counts with zero
    # ---------------------------------
    across(
      matches("^(total_counts_|dru_.*_counts$|dru_.*_counts_at_bl$|dru_.*_counts_1yp$)"),
      replace_na0
    ),

    # ---------------------------------
    # Fixed dates
    # ---------------------------------
    follow_up_beg = follow_up_beg_date,
    follow_up_end = follow_up_end_date,
    cutoff_date = cutoff_date_const,

    # ---------------------------------

    dementia = as.integer(total_counts_dementia > 0),
    zoster = as.integer(total_counts_zoster > 0),

    unspecified_dementia_1yp = as.integer(total_counts_unspecified_dementia_1yp > 0),
    other_dementia_1yp = as.integer(total_counts_other_dementia_1yp > 0),
    other_dementia_2_1yp = as.integer(total_counts_other_dementia_2_1yp > 0),

    # ---------------------------------
    # Derived covariates
    # ---------------------------------
    running_var_days = as.numeric(difftime(DOB, cutoff_date, units = "days")),
    GENDER = factor(GENDER),
    ETHNICGP = as.character(ETHNICGP),

    ethnicity = case_when(
      is.na(ETHNICGP) ~ "Missing",
      startsWith(ETHNICGP, "1") ~ "European",
      startsWith(ETHNICGP, "2") ~ "Maori",
      startsWith(ETHNICGP, "3") ~ "Pacific Peoples",
      startsWith(ETHNICGP, "4") ~ "Asian",
      startsWith(ETHNICGP, "5") | startsWith(ETHNICGP, "6") | startsWith(ETHNICGP, "9") ~ "Others"
    ),
    ethnicity_factor = factor(ethnicity),

    Dep18 = as.numeric(Dep18),
    deprivation_index = case_when(
      is.na(Dep18) ~ "Missing",
      Dep18 >= 1 & Dep18 <= 2 ~ "1",
      Dep18 >= 3 & Dep18 <= 4 ~ "2",
      Dep18 >= 5 & Dep18 <= 6 ~ "3",
      Dep18 >= 7 & Dep18 <= 8 ~ "4",
      Dep18 >= 9 & Dep18 <= 10 ~ "5",
      TRUE ~ "Missing"
    ),
    deprivation_index_factor = factor(
      deprivation_index,
      levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "Missing")
    )
  )
```

# Flow chart corresponding to incidence sample

```{r}
# Flow chart corresponding to incidence sample

# -----------------------------
# Constants
# -----------------------------
contact_cutoff_date <- as.Date("2023-06-01")
flowchart_dir <- table_dir
flowchart_svg_path <- file.path(flowchart_dir, "flowchart.svg")
flowchart_pdf_path <- file.path(flowchart_dir, "flowchart.pdf")

dir.create(flowchart_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# Helper
# -----------------------------
fmt_n_pct <- function(n, denom) {
  sprintf("%s, (%.2f%%)", format(n, big.mark = ","), 100 * n / denom)
}

# -----------------------------
# Cohort counts
# -----------------------------
df_raw <- data

n_start <- nrow(df_raw)

df_step1 <- df_raw %>%
  filter(DOB >= follow_up_beg - years(95))
n_after_step1 <- nrow(df_step1)

df_step2 <- df_step1 %>%
  filter(is.na(DOD))
n_after_step2 <- nrow(df_step2)

df_step3 <- df_step2 %>%
  filter(most_recent_date >= contact_cutoff_date)
n_after_step3 <- nrow(df_step3)

df_step4 <- df_step3 %>%
  filter(is.na(first_dementia_overall) | first_dementia_overall >= follow_up_beg)
n_final <- nrow(df_step4)

# -----------------------------
# Labels
# -----------------------------
lab_start <- paste0(
  "All eligible records\nN = ",
  format(n_start, big.mark = ",")
)

lab_step1 <- paste0(
  "Age < 95 at program start\n",
  "Remaining N = ", fmt_n_pct(n_after_step1, n_start), "\n",
  "Excluded = ", fmt_n_pct(n_start - n_after_step1, n_start)
)

lab_step2 <- paste0(
  "No recorded death in follow-up period\n",
  "Remaining N = ", fmt_n_pct(n_after_step2, n_start), "\n",
  "Excluded = ", fmt_n_pct(n_start - n_after_step2, n_start)
)

lab_step3 <- paste0(
  "Last recorded event on or after 2023-06-01\n",
  "Remaining N = ", fmt_n_pct(n_after_step3, n_start), "\n",
  "Excluded = ", fmt_n_pct(n_start - n_after_step3, n_start)
)

lab_step4 <- paste0(
  "No dementia diagnosis at baseline\n",
  "Final analytic cohort\n",
  "N = ", fmt_n_pct(n_final, n_start), "\n",
  "Excluded = ", fmt_n_pct(n_start - n_final, n_start)
)

# -----------------------------
# Render flow chart
# -----------------------------
flow <- grViz(paste0(
"
digraph cohort_flow {

  graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB]

  node [shape=box, fontname=Helvetica, fontsize=12,
        width=3.5, style='rounded,filled', fillcolor=gray95,
        color=black]

  edge [color=black, arrowsize=0.6]

  start [label = '", lab_start, "']
  step1 [label = '", lab_step1, "']
  step2 [label = '", lab_step2, "']
  step3 [label = '", lab_step3, "']
  step4 [label = '", lab_step4, "']

  start -> step1 -> step2 -> step3 -> step4
}
"
))

# Manuscript reference: Figure S1.
flow

# -----------------------------
# Export
# -----------------------------
DiagrammeRsvg::export_svg(flow) |>
  charToRaw() |>
  writeBin(flowchart_svg_path)

rsvg::rsvg_pdf(flowchart_svg_path, flowchart_pdf_path)

rm(df_raw, df_step1, df_step2, df_step3, df_step4)
```

# Estimation

## First Stage

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# Estimation and uptake plot ---------------------------------------------------

# -----------------------------
# Constants
# -----------------------------
plot_dir <- table_dir
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

bin_size <- 365 / 6
limit <- 3 * 365

facet_labels <- c(
  "full"   = "Full sample",
  "female" = "Female sample",
  "male"   = "Male sample"
)

# -----------------------------
# RD estimation helper
# -----------------------------
run_hz_rd <- function(data) {
  rdrobust(
    y          = data$hz_vacc,
    x          = data$running_var_days,
    c          = 0,
    p          = 1,
    scaleregul = 0,
    vce        = "nn",
    bwselect   = "mserd",
    masspoints = "adjust"
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Plot data helper
# -----------------------------
build_hz_plot_components <- function(data, rd_fit, sample_label,
                                     bin_size = 365 / 6,
                                     limit = 3 * 365) {

  bw <- as.numeric(rd_fit$bws["h", 1])

  # Binned scatter data
  data_plot <- data %>%
    mutate(
      running_var_bin = cut(
        running_var_days,
        breaks = seq(-limit, limit, by = bin_size),
        include.lowest = TRUE,
        right = FALSE,
        labels = FALSE
      ),
      eligible = as.numeric(running_var_days >= 0),
      tria_weights = pmax(0, 1 - abs(running_var_days) / bw)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(running_var_bin)) %>%
    group_by(running_var_bin, eligible) %>%
    summarise(
      hz_vacc_binned = mean(hz_vacc, na.rm = TRUE),
      tria_weights_binned = mean(tria_weights, na.rm = TRUE),
      running_var_days_mean = mean(running_var_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(running_var_bin, eligible)

  # Identify the bin containing zero
  zero_bin <- data_plot %>%
    filter(running_var_days_mean >= 0) %>%
    arrange(running_var_days_mean) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(running_var_bin)

  if (length(zero_bin) == 0 || is.na(zero_bin)) {
    stop(sprintf("Could not identify the zero bin for sample '%s'.", sample_label), call. = FALSE)
  }

  data_plot <- data_plot %>%
    mutate(
      running_var_bin = as.numeric((running_var_bin - zero_bin) * bin_size),
      eligible = factor(eligible),
      sample = factor(sample_label, levels = c("full", "female", "male")),
      hz_vacc_binned = hz_vacc_binned * 100
    ) %>%
    select(sample, running_var_bin, hz_vacc_binned, eligible, tria_weights_binned)

  # RD fit lines within bandwidth
  data_lines <- tibble::tibble(
    running_var_days = seq(
      from = min(data$running_var_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      to = max(data$running_var_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      by = 1
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      y_outcome_right = rd_fit$beta_Y_p_r[1] + running_var_days * rd_fit$beta_Y_p_r[2],
      y_outcome_left  = rd_fit$beta_Y_p_l[1] + running_var_days * rd_fit$beta_Y_p_l[2],
      eligible = as.numeric(running_var_days >= 0),
      inside_bandwidth = running_var_days >= -bw & running_var_days <= bw
    ) %>%
    filter(inside_bandwidth) %>%
    transmute(
      running_var_days,
      y_outcome = if_else(eligible == 1, y_outcome_right, y_outcome_left) * 100,
      eligible,
      sample = factor(sample_label, levels = c("full", "female", "male"))
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  # Bandwidth shading info
  bw_df <- tibble::tibble(
    sample = factor(sample_label, levels = c("full", "female", "male")),
    bw_start_date = -bw,
    bw_end_date = bw
  )

  # Annotation label
  p_val_text <- if (rd_fit$pv[3] < 0.001) {
    "p < 0.001"
  } else {
    paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.3f", rd_fit$pv[3]))
  }

  ann_df <- tibble::tibble(
    sample = factor(sample_label, levels = c("full", "female", "male")),
    label = paste0(
      "Coef. = ", sprintf("%.1f", rd_fit$coef[1, 1] * 100),
      "\n(95% CI: ", sprintf("%.1f", rd_fit$ci[3, 1] * 100),
      " to ", sprintf("%.1f", rd_fit$ci[3, 2] * 100), ")",
      "\n", p_val_text
    ),
    x = -1.5 * 365,
    y = Inf
  )

  list(
    data_plot = data_plot,
    data_lines = data_lines,
    bw_df = bw_df,
    ann_df = ann_df
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Prepare samples
# -----------------------------
data_main.female <- data_main %>% filter(GENDER == "F")
data_main.male   <- data_main %>% filter(GENDER == "M")

# -----------------------------
# Run RD estimations
# -----------------------------
rdr_estimation_nc_vu <- run_hz_rd(data_main)
rdr_estimation_nc_vu_female <- run_hz_rd(data_main.female)
rdr_estimation_nc_vu_male <- run_hz_rd(data_main.male)

# Model summaries
summary(rdr_estimation_nc_vu)
summary(rdr_estimation_nc_vu_female)
summary(rdr_estimation_nc_vu_male)

# -----------------------------
# Build plot components
# -----------------------------
plot_components_full <- build_hz_plot_components(
  data = data_main,
  rd_fit = rdr_estimation_nc_vu,
  sample_label = "full",
  bin_size = bin_size,
  limit = limit
)

plot_components_female <- build_hz_plot_components(
  data = data_main.female,
  rd_fit = rdr_estimation_nc_vu_female,
  sample_label = "female",
  bin_size = bin_size,
  limit = limit
)

plot_components_male <- build_hz_plot_components(
  data = data_main.male,
  rd_fit = rdr_estimation_nc_vu_male,
  sample_label = "male",
  bin_size = bin_size,
  limit = limit
)

data_plot_fw <- bind_rows(
  plot_components_full$data_plot,
  plot_components_female$data_plot,
  plot_components_male$data_plot
)

data_lines_df <- bind_rows(
  plot_components_full$data_lines,
  plot_components_female$data_lines,
  plot_components_male$data_lines
)

bw_df <- bind_rows(
  plot_components_full$bw_df,
  plot_components_female$bw_df,
  plot_components_male$bw_df
)

ann_df <- bind_rows(
  plot_components_full$ann_df,
  plot_components_female$ann_df,
  plot_components_male$ann_df
)

# -----------------------------
# Final combined faceted plot
# -----------------------------
plot_hz_vacc_combined_fw <- ggplot(
  data_plot_fw,
  aes(x = running_var_bin, y = hz_vacc_binned, group = eligible)
) +
  geom_rect(
    data = bw_df,
    aes(
      xmin = bw_start_date,
      xmax = bw_end_date,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf
    ),
    fill = "gray",
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = ann_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 1.10,
    size = 3,
    fill = "white",
    label.r = unit(0, "lines"),
    label.size = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = tria_weights_binned, col = eligible, size = tria_weights_binned)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 3)) +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.1, 0.9)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#D81B60", "#1E88E5")) +
  geom_line(
    data = data_lines_df,
    aes(x = running_var_days, y = y_outcome, group = eligible),
    color = "black",
    lty = "solid",
    lwd = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, lty = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(from = -2 * 365, to = 2 * 365, by = 365),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.03)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of days from April 2, 1937",
    y = "Ever received HZ vaccination (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 1.1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.line = element_line(),
    axis.ticks = element_line()
  ) +
  guides(color = FALSE, size = FALSE, alpha = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~sample, labeller = as_labeller(facet_labels))

# Manuscript reference: Figure 1.
plot_hz_vacc_combined_fw

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "plot_hz_vacc_combined_fw.pdf"),
  plot = plot_hz_vacc_combined_fw,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  units = "in"
)

```

## Herpes Zoster / Shingles

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Full sample ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Incidence instead of prevalence
data_main_zoster <- data_main %>%
  filter(is.na(first_zoster_overall) | first_zoster_overall >= follow_up_beg)

# Subsamples
data_main_zoster.female <- data_main_zoster %>% filter(GENDER == "F")
data_main_zoster.male   <- data_main_zoster %>% filter(GENDER == "M")

# Estimation helper ------------------------------------------------------------
run_zoster_rd <- function(data) {
  rdrobust(
    y          = data$zoster,
    x          = data$running_var_days,
    fuzzy      = data$hz_vacc,
    c          = 0,
    p          = 1,
    scaleregul = 0,
    vce        = "nn",
    bwselect   = "mserd",
    masspoints = "adjust"
  )
}

# Run RD estimations -----------------------------------------------------------
rdr_estimation_nc_zoster <- run_zoster_rd(data_main_zoster)
rdr_estimation.female_first_stage <- run_zoster_rd(data_main_zoster.female)
rdr_estimation.male_first_stage   <- run_zoster_rd(data_main_zoster.male)

# Model summaries
summary(rdr_estimation_nc_zoster)
summary(rdr_estimation.female_first_stage)
summary(rdr_estimation.male_first_stage)

# Forestplot data --------------------------------------------------------------
rd.result.list <- list(
  rdr_estimation_nc_zoster,
  rdr_estimation.female_first_stage,
  rdr_estimation.male_first_stage
)

specification_name <- c("Full sample", "Females", "Males")

fp.df <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  rd.result.list,
  specification_name,
  ~ tibble::tibble(
    section = "Main (unadjusted)",
    coef = as.numeric(.x$coef[1, 1]),
    lower = as.numeric(.x$ci[3, 1]),
    upper = as.numeric(.x$ci[3, 2]),
    se = as.numeric(.x$se[3, 1]),
    bw = round(as.numeric(.x$bws[1, 1]), digits = 0),
    pvalue = as.numeric(.x$pv[3, 1]),
    intercept_l = as.numeric(.x$beta_Y_p_l[1]),
    specification = .y
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    coef.r = coef / intercept_l,
    lower.r = lower / intercept_l,
    upper.r = upper / intercept_l
  ) %>%
  select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, pvalue, coef.r, lower.r, upper.r, specification)

df.list <- fp.df %>%
  group_by(section) %>%
  group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
  lapply(as.data.frame)

for (i in seq_along(df.list)) {
  df_i <- df.list[[i]]

  df_i[nrow(df_i) + 1, ] <- c(df_i %>% pull(section) %>% unique(), rep("", ncol(df_i) - 1))
  df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), 1] <- df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), "specification"]
  df_i <- df_i[c(nrow(df_i), 1:(nrow(df_i) - 1)), -ncol(df_i)]
  df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1] <- paste0("     ", df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1])

  df_i <- df_i %>%
    mutate(
      coef   = as.numeric(coef) * 100,
      lower  = as.numeric(lower) * 100,
      upper  = as.numeric(upper) * 100,
      coef.r = as.numeric(coef.r) * 100,
      lower.r = as.numeric(lower.r) * 100,
      upper.r = as.numeric(upper.r) * 100,
      pvalue = as.numeric(pvalue),
      pvalue = base::sprintf("%.3f", pvalue),
      pvalue = if_else(pvalue == "0.000", "< 0.001", pvalue),
      se = as.numeric(se),
      bw = floor(as.numeric(bw)),
      `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef, lower, upper)),
      `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef.r, lower.r, upper.r)),
      ` ` = paste(rep(" ", 30), collapse = " ")
    ) %>%
    select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)`, `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)`, pvalue, ` `) %>%
    rename(
      Specification = section,
      Bandwidth = bw,
      p = pvalue
    )

  df_i[1, c(6:10)] <- ""
  df.list[[i]] <- df_i
}

forestplot.df <- do.call(rbind, df.list)

forest.plot.list.shingles <- vector("list", 3)
forest.plot.list.shingles[[1]] <- forestplot.df
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Subsamples
data_main_p.female <- data_main_p %>% filter(GENDER == "F")
data_main_p.male   <- data_main_p %>% filter(GENDER == "M")

# Estimation helper ------------------------------------------------------------
run_dementia_rd <- function(y, x, fuzzy, covs = NULL) {
  rdrobust(
    y          = y,
    x          = x,
    fuzzy      = fuzzy,
    c          = 0,
    p          = 1,
    scaleregul = 0,
    vce        = "nn",
    bwselect   = "mserd",
    kernel     = "triangular",
    masspoints = "adjust",
    covs       = covs
  )
}

# Formatting helper ------------------------------------------------------------
format_fp_block <- function(rd_result_list, specification_name, section_label = "Prevalence") {
  fp.df <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    rd_result_list,
    specification_name,
    ~ tibble::tibble(
      section = section_label,
      coef = as.numeric(.x$coef[1, 1]),
      lower = as.numeric(.x$ci[3, 1]),
      upper = as.numeric(.x$ci[3, 2]),
      se = as.numeric(.x$se[3, 1]),
      bw = round(as.numeric(.x$bws[1, 1]), digits = 0),
      pvalue = as.numeric(.x$pv[3, 1]),
      intercept_l = as.numeric(.x$beta_Y_p_l[1]),
      specification = .y
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      coef.r = coef / intercept_l,
      lower.r = lower / intercept_l,
      upper.r = upper / intercept_l
    ) %>%
    select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, pvalue, coef.r, lower.r, upper.r, specification)

  df.list <- fp.df %>%
    group_by(section) %>%
    group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
    lapply(as.data.frame)

  for (i in seq_along(df.list)) {
    df_i <- df.list[[i]]

    df_i[nrow(df_i) + 1, ] <- c(df_i %>% pull(section) %>% unique(), rep("", ncol(df_i) - 1))
    df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), 1] <- df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), "specification"]
    df_i <- df_i[c(nrow(df_i), 1:(nrow(df_i) - 1)), -ncol(df_i)]
    df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1] <- paste0("     ", df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1])

    df_i <- df_i %>%
      mutate(
        coef   = as.numeric(coef) * 100,
        lower  = as.numeric(lower) * 100,
        upper  = as.numeric(upper) * 100,
        coef.r = as.numeric(coef.r) * 100,
        lower.r = as.numeric(lower.r) * 100,
        upper.r = as.numeric(upper.r) * 100,
        pvalue = as.numeric(pvalue),
        pvalue = base::sprintf("%.3f", pvalue),
        pvalue = if_else(pvalue == "0.000", "< 0.001", pvalue),
        se = as.numeric(se),
        bw = floor(as.numeric(bw)),
        `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(
          is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef, lower, upper)
        ),
        `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(
          is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef.r, lower.r, upper.r)
        ),
        ` ` = paste(rep(" ", 30), collapse = " ")
      ) %>%
      select(
        section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw,
        `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)`,
        `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)`,
        pvalue, ` `
      ) %>%
      rename(
        Specification = section,
        Bandwidth = bw,
        p = pvalue
      )

    df_i[1, c(6:10)] <- ""
    df.list[[i]] <- df_i
  }

  do.call(rbind, df.list)
}
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# Uptake of other vaccines (PCV13, Influenza, 23PPV) ---------------------------

# Estimation helper ------------------------------------------------------------
run_vaccine_rd <- function(y, x, p) {
  rdrobust(
    y          = y,
    x          = x,
    c          = 0,
    p          = p,
    scaleregul = 0,
    vce        = "nn",
    bwselect   = "mserd",
    masspoints = "adjust"
  )
}

# Formatting helper ------------------------------------------------------------
format_other_vaccine_results <- function(rd_list, outcome_names, sample_label) {
  purrr::map2_dfr(
    rd_list,
    outcome_names,
    ~ tibble::tibble(
      section = sample_label,
      coef = as.numeric(.x$coef[1]),
      lower = as.numeric(.x$ci[3, 1]),
      upper = as.numeric(.x$ci[3, 2]),
      se = as.numeric(.x$coef[3]),
      bw = round(as.numeric(.x$bws[1, 1]), digits = 0),
      pvalue = as.numeric(.x$pv[3]),
      intercept_l = as.numeric(.x$beta_Y_p_l[1]),
      specification = .y,
      coef.r = coef / intercept_l,
      lower.r = lower / intercept_l,
      upper.r = upper / intercept_l
    )
  )
}

# Full sample ------------------------------------------------------------------
rdr_est_pcv_vacc <- run_vaccine_rd(

# Forest plot for uptake of other vaccines -------------------------------------
outcome_names <- c("PCV13", "23PPV", "Influenza", "Influenza (count)")

fp.df <- bind_rows(
  format_other_vaccine_results(
    rd_list = list(rdr_est_pcv_vacc, rdr_est_ppv_vacc, rdr_est_inf_vacc, rdr_est_ico_vacc),
    outcome_names = outcome_names,
    sample_label = "Full sample"
  ),
  format_other_vaccine_results(
    rd_list = list(rdr_est_pcv_vacc.f, rdr_est_ppv_vacc.f, rdr_est_inf_vacc.f, rdr_est_ico_vacc.f),
    outcome_names = outcome_names,
    sample_label = "Females"
  ),
  format_other_vaccine_results(
    rd_list = list(rdr_est_pcv_vacc.m, rdr_est_ppv_vacc.m, rdr_est_inf_vacc.m, rdr_est_ico_vacc.m),
    outcome_names = outcome_names,
    sample_label = "Males"
  )
) %>%
  filter(specification != "Influenza (count)") %>%
  select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, pvalue, coef.r, lower.r, upper.r, specification)

df.list <- fp.df %>%
  group_by(section) %>%
  group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
  lapply(as.data.frame)

for (i in seq_along(df.list)) {
  df_i <- df.list[[i]]

  df_i[nrow(df_i) + 1, ] <- c(df_i %>% pull(section) %>% unique(), rep("", ncol(df_i) - 1))
  df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), 1] <- df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), "specification"]
  df_i <- df_i[c(nrow(df_i), 1:(nrow(df_i) - 1)), -ncol(df_i)]
  df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1] <- paste0("     ", df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1])

  df_i <- df_i %>%
    mutate(
      coef   = as.numeric(coef) * 100,
      lower  = as.numeric(lower) * 100,
      upper  = as.numeric(upper) * 100,
      coef.r = as.numeric(coef.r) * 100,
      lower.r = as.numeric(lower.r) * 100,
      upper.r = as.numeric(upper.r) * 100,
      pvalue = as.numeric(pvalue),
      pvalue = base::sprintf("%.3f", pvalue),
      pvalue = if_else(pvalue == "0.000", "< 0.001", pvalue),
      se = as.numeric(se),
      bw = floor(as.numeric(bw)),
      `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(
        is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef, lower, upper)
      ),
      `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(
        is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef.r, lower.r, upper.r)
      ),
      ` ` = paste(rep(" ", 30), collapse = " ")
    ) %>%
    select(
      section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw,
      `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)`,
      `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)`,
      pvalue, ` `
    ) %>%
    rename(
      Outcome = section,
      Bandwidth = bw,
      p = pvalue
    )

  df_i[1, c(6:10)] <- ""
  df.list[[i]] <- df_i
}

forestplot.df <- rbind(df.list[[2]], df.list[[1]], df.list[[3]]) %>%
  mutate(se = 1)

tm <- forest_theme(
  core = list(
    bg_params = list(fill = c("#D6EAF8", "#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF", "#FFFFFF"))
  ),
  ci_pch = c(15),
  refline_lty = "dotted",
  refline_col = c("#000000"),
  base_size = 10,
  ci_Theight = 0.5,
  ci_col = "black",
  ci_fill = "#67a9cf"
)

p <- forest(

  lower = forestplot.df$lower,
```

## Rolling bandwidth plots

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=11}
# Rolling bandwidth plots ------------------------------------------------------

# MSE-optimal bandwidths from above estimations
bw_main <- rdr_estimation_nc$bws["h", 1]
bw_main_female <- rdr_estimation.female$bws["h", 1]
bw_main_male <- rdr_estimation.male$bws["h", 1]

# Bandwidth sequences for rolling BW
bw_main_seq <- seq(from = 0.5 * bw_main, to = 1.5 * bw_main, by = 0.1 * bw_main)
bw_main_seq_female <- seq(from = 0.5 * bw_main_female, to = 1.5 * bw_main_female, by = 0.1 * bw_main_female)
bw_main_seq_male <- seq(from = 0.5 * bw_main_male, to = 1.5 * bw_main_male, by = 0.1 * bw_main_male)

bw_seq_steps <- paste0(seq(from = 0.5, to = 1.5, by = 0.1) * 100, "%")

# Helper -----------------------------------------------------------------------
run_rolling_bw <- function(data, base_fit, bw_seq, sample_label, bw_labels) {
  rho_val <- base_fit$bws["h", 1] / base_fit$bws["b", 1]

  out_df <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    bw_seq,
    bw_labels,
    function(h_val, bw_lab) {
      fit <- rdrobust(
        y = data$dementia,
        x = data$running_var_days,
        fuzzy = data$hz_vacc,
        c = 0,
        p = 1,
        vce = "nn",
        masspoints = "adjust",
        rho = rho_val,
        h = h_val
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        section = sample_label,
        coef = as.numeric(fit$coef[1]),
        lower = as.numeric(fit$ci[3, 1]),
        upper = as.numeric(fit$ci[3, 2]),
        se = as.numeric(fit$se[3, 1]),
        bw = floor(h_val),
        pvalue = as.numeric(fit$pv[3, 1]),
        intercept_l = as.numeric(fit$beta_Y_p_l[1]),
        specification = bw_lab,
        coef.r = coef / intercept_l,
        lower.r = lower / intercept_l,
        upper.r = upper / intercept_l
      )
    }
  )

  out_df
}

# Run rolling-BW estimations ---------------------------------------------------
rolling_bw_plot_df <- run_rolling_bw(
  data = data_main,
  base_fit = rdr_estimation_nc,
  bw_seq = bw_main_seq,
  sample_label = "Full sample",
  bw_labels = bw_seq_steps
)

)

# Forestplot -------------------------------------------------------------------

      `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef, lower, upper)),
      `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef.r, lower.r, upper.r)),

  df_i <- df_i %>%
```

## Negative control outcome analysis - prevalence over follow-up

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=18}
## Negative control outcome analysis - prevalence over follow-up ----------------

baseline_check_outcomes <- c(
  "ihd", "copd", "lri", "cancer_lung", "cancer_colorectal",
  "ckd", "osteoarthritis", "stroke", "dm", "atf", "cancer_pancreatic",
  "parkinsons", "lymphoma", "leukaemia", "falls", "aortic_aneurysm", "nrvd",
  "oral_disorders", "age_related_hearing_loss", "rheumatological_diseases"
)

display.names.df <- tibble::tibble(
  Outcome = baseline_check_outcomes,
  Outcome_to_display = c(
    "Ischemic heart disease",
    "COPD",
    "Lower respiratory tract infection",
    "Lung cancer",
    "Colorectal cancer",
    "Chronic kidney disease",
    "Osteoarthritis",
    "Stroke",
    "Diabetes Mellitus",
    "Atrial fibrillation",
    "Pancreatic cancer",
    "Parkinson's disease",
    "Lymphoma",
    "Leukemia",
    "Falls",
    "Aortic aneurysm",
    "Non-rheumatic valve disease",
    "Oral disorders",
    "Age-related hearing loss",
    "Rheumatological diseases"
  )
)

scale_regul_choice <- 0

# Local copies for this chunk only ---------------------------------------------
data_main_nco <- data_main %>%
  mutate(deprivation_index_factor = as.numeric(deprivation_index_factor))

data_main_female_nco <- data_main.female %>%
  mutate(deprivation_index_factor = as.numeric(deprivation_index_factor))

data_main_male_nco <- data_main.male %>%
  mutate(deprivation_index_factor = as.numeric(deprivation_index_factor))

# Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------
run_nco_models <- function(data, outcomes, sample_label, scale_regul_choice = 0) {
  n_outcomes <- length(outcomes)
  result_list <- vector("list", n_outcomes)

  comparison_table <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    outcomes,
    seq_along(outcomes),
    function(outcome_name, i) {
      fit <- rdrobust(
        y = data %>% pull(outcome_name) %>% as.numeric(),
        x = data$running_var_days,
        fuzzy = data$hz_vacc,
        c = 0,
        p = 1,
        scaleregul = scale_regul_choice,
        vce = "nn",
        bwselect = "cerrd",
        kernel = "triangular",
        masspoints = "adjust"
      )

      result_list[[i]] <<- fit

      message(sprintf("%.3f%% of 100%%", round(i / n_outcomes * 100, digits = 3)))

      tibble::tibble(
        sample = sample_label,
        Coef = as.numeric(fit$coef[1]),
        lower = as.numeric(fit$ci[3, 1]),
        upper = as.numeric(fit$ci[3, 2]),
        se = as.numeric(fit$se[3, 1]),
        BW = as.numeric(fit$bws["h", 1]),
        PV = as.numeric(fit$pv[3]),
        intercept = as.numeric(fit$beta_Y_p_l[1]),
        Outcome = outcome_name
      )
    }
  )

  list(
    results = result_list,
    table = comparison_table
  )
}

format_nco_for_forest <- function(comparison_table, display_names_df) {
  comparison_table %>%
    arrange(tolower(Outcome)) %>%
    left_join(display_names_df, by = "Outcome") %>%
    select(-Outcome) %>%
    rename(Outcome = Outcome_to_display) %>%
    mutate(
      section = sample,
      coef = as.numeric(Coef),
      lower = as.numeric(lower),
      upper = as.numeric(upper),
      se = as.numeric(se),
      bw = floor(as.numeric(BW)),
      pvalue = as.numeric(PV),
      intercept_l = as.numeric(intercept),
      specification = Outcome,
      coef.r = coef / intercept_l,
      lower.r = lower / intercept_l,
      upper.r = upper / intercept_l
    ) %>%
    select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, pvalue, coef.r, lower.r, upper.r, specification)
}

make_forest_table <- function(fp_df, first_col_name) {
  df.list <- fp_df %>%
    group_by(section) %>%
    group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
    lapply(as.data.frame)

  for (i in seq_along(df.list)) {
    df_i <- df.list[[i]]

    df_i[nrow(df_i) + 1, ] <- c(df_i %>% pull(section) %>% unique(), rep("", ncol(df_i) - 1))
    df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), 1] <- df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), "specification"]
    df_i <- df_i[c(nrow(df_i), 1:(nrow(df_i) - 1)), -ncol(df_i)]
    df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1] <- paste0("     ", df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1])

    df_i <- df_i %>%
      mutate(
        coef = as.numeric(coef) * 100,
        lower = as.numeric(lower) * 100,
        upper = as.numeric(upper) * 100,
        coef.r = as.numeric(coef.r) * 100,
        lower.r = as.numeric(lower.r) * 100,
        upper.r = as.numeric(upper.r) * 100,
        pvalue = as.numeric(pvalue),
        pvalue = base::sprintf("%.3f", pvalue),
        pvalue = if_else(pvalue == "0.000", "< 0.001", pvalue),
        se = as.numeric(se),
        bw = floor(as.numeric(bw)),
        `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef, lower, upper)),
        `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef.r, lower.r, upper.r)),
        ` ` = paste(rep(" ", 30), collapse = " ")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)`, `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)`, pvalue, ` `)

    names(df_i)[1] <- first_col_name
    names(df_i)[6] <- "Bandwidth"
    names(df_i)[9] <- "p"

    df_i[1, c(6:10)] <- ""
    df.list[[i]] <- df_i
  }

  df.list
}

save_forestplot_pdf <- function(forestplot_df, path, width, height, xlim = c(-20, 20), ticks_at = c(-20, -10, 0, 10, 20), bg_fill = c("#D6EAF8", rep("#FFFFFF", 20))) {
  tm <- forest_theme(
    core = list(bg_params = list(fill = bg_fill)),
    ci_pch = c(15),
    refline_lty = "dotted",
    refline_col = c("#000000"),
    base_size = 10,
    ci_Theight = 0.5,
    ci_col = "black",
    ci_fill = "#67a9cf"
  )

  forestplot_df <- forestplot_df %>%
    mutate(se = 1)

  p <- forest(
    forestplot_df[, c(1, 6:10)],
    est = forestplot_df$coef,
    lower = forestplot_df$lower,
    upper = forestplot_df$upper,
    sizes = forestplot_df$se * 0.5,
    ci_column = 6,
    ref_line = 0,
    xlim = xlim,
    ticks_at = ticks_at,
    xlab = "Absolute effect (% points)",
    theme = tm
  )

  plot(p)
  pdf(path, width = width, height = height)
  print(p)
  dev.off()

  invisible(p)
}
```

## Negative control outcome analysis - at baseline

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=18}
## Negative control outcome analysis - at baseline -----------------------------

baseline_check_outcomes <- c(

)

# Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------
run_nco_baseline_models <- function(data, outcomes, sample_label, scale_regul_choice = 0) {
  n_outcomes <- length(outcomes)
  result_list <- vector("list", n_outcomes)

  comparison_table <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    outcomes,
    seq_along(outcomes),
    function(outcome_name, i) {
      fit <- rdrobust(
        y = data %>% pull(outcome_name) %>% as.numeric(),
        x = data$running_var_days,
        fuzzy = data$hz_vacc,
        c = 0,
        p = 1,
        scaleregul = scale_regul_choice,
        vce = "nn",
        bwselect = "cerrd",
        kernel = "triangular",
        masspoints = "adjust"
      )

      result_list[[i]] <<- fit

      message(sprintf("%.3f%% of 100%%", round(i / n_outcomes * 100, digits = 3)))

      tibble::tibble(
        Outcome = outcome_name,
        Coef = as.numeric(fit$coef[1]),
        lower = as.numeric(fit$ci[3, 1]),
        upper = as.numeric(fit$ci[3, 2]),
        se = as.numeric(fit$se[3, 1]),
        BW = as.numeric(fit$bws["h", 1]),
        PV = as.numeric(fit$pv[3]),
        sample = sample_label
      )
    }
  )

  list(
    results = result_list,
    table = comparison_table
  )
}

# Run models -------------------------------------------------------------------
full_fit <- run_nco_baseline_models(
  data = data_main_nco_bl,
  outcomes = baseline_check_outcomes,
  sample_label = "Full sample",
  scale_regul_choice = scale_regul_choice
)

female_fit <- run_nco_baseline_models(
  data = data_main_female_nco_bl,
  outcomes = baseline_check_outcomes,
  sample_label = "Females",
  scale_regul_choice = scale_regul_choice
)

male_fit <- run_nco_baseline_models(
  data = data_main_male_nco_bl,
  outcomes = baseline_check_outcomes,
  sample_label = "Males",
  scale_regul_choice = scale_regul_choice
)

comparison_table_bic <- full_fit$table
comparison_table_bic_female <- female_fit$table
comparison_table_bic_male <- male_fit$table

combined_comparison_table <- bind_rows(
  comparison_table_bic,
  comparison_table_bic_female,
  comparison_table_bic_male
) %>%
  arrange(tolower(Outcome)) %>%
  left_join(display.names.df, by = "Outcome") %>%
  select(-Outcome) %>%
  rename(Outcome = Outcome_to_display) %>%
  select(Outcome, Coef, lower, upper, se, BW, PV, sample)

# Build forestplot table -------------------------------------------------------
nco_vec <- unique(display.names.df$Outcome_to_display)[order(unique(display.names.df$Outcome_to_display))]
df.list <- vector("list", length(nco_vec))

for (i in seq_along(df.list)) {
  df_i <- combined_comparison_table %>%
    filter(Outcome == nco_vec[i]) %>%
    as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # safety check: skip if somehow no rows found
  if (nrow(df_i) == 0) {
    next
  }

  # replace first column with sample names for the actual result rows
  df_i[, "Outcome"] <- df_i[, "sample"]

  # drop sample column
  df_i <- df_i[, setdiff(names(df_i), "sample"), drop = FALSE]

  # prepend header row
  header_row <- as.data.frame(
    as.list(c(nco_vec[i], rep("", ncol(df_i) - 1))),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  names(header_row) <- names(df_i)

  df_i <- rbind(header_row, df_i)

  # indent sample rows
  if (nrow(df_i) >= 2) {
    df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1] <- paste0("     ", df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1])
  }

  df_i <- df_i %>%
    mutate(
      coef = as.numeric(Coef),
      lower = as.numeric(lower),
      upper = as.numeric(upper),
      pvalue = round(as.numeric(PV), digits = 3),
      se = as.numeric(se),
      BW = round(as.numeric(BW), digits = 0),
      `Coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(
        is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.4f (%.4f, %.4f)", coef, lower, upper)
      ),
      ` ` = paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " ")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Outcome, coef, lower, upper, se, BW, `Coef. (95% CI)`, pvalue, ` `) %>%
    rename(
      Bandwidth = BW,
      p = pvalue
    )

  # blank out header-row statistic columns
  df_i[1, "se"] <- NA
  df_i[1, c("Bandwidth", "Coef. (95% CI)", "p")] <- ""

  df.list[[i]] <- df_i
}


forestplot.df <- do.call(rbind, df.list)

tm <- forest_theme(
  core = list(
    bg_params = list(fill = c("#D6EAF8", rep("#FFFFFF", 3)))
  ),
  ci_pch = c(15),
  refline_lty = "dotted",
  refline_col = c("#000000"),
  base_size = 10,
  ci_Theight = 0.5,
  ci_col = "black",
  ci_fill = "#67a9cf"
)

forestplot.df <- forestplot.df %>%
  mutate(se = 1)

p <- forest(
  forestplot.df[, c(1, 6:9)],
  est = forestplot.df$coef,
  lower = forestplot.df$lower,
  upper = forestplot.df$upper,
  sizes = forestplot.df$se * 0.5,
  ci_column = 5,
  ref_line = 0,
  xlim = c(-0.2, 0.2),
  ticks_at = c(-0.2, -0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.2),
  theme = tm
)

# Manuscript reference: baseline negative-control balance checks; see Supplementary Appendix.
plot(p)

path <- paste0(
  file.path(table_dir, "forestplot_nco_at_bl_scale_regul_"),
  scale_regul_choice,
  ".pdf"
)

pdf(path, width = 10, height = 18)
print(p)
dev.off()
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------
run_bc_models <- function(data, outcomes, sample_label, scale_regul_choice = 0) {
  n_outcomes <- length(outcomes)
  result_list <- vector("list", n_outcomes)

  comparison_table <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    outcomes,
    seq_along(outcomes),
    function(outcome_name, i) {
      fit <- rdrobust(
        y = data %>% pull(outcome_name) %>% as.numeric(),
        x = data$running_var_days,
        fuzzy = data$hz_vacc,
        c = 0,
        p = 1,
        scaleregul = scale_regul_choice,
        vce = "nn",
        bwselect = "cerrd",
        kernel = "triangular",
        masspoints = "adjust"
      )

      result_list[[i]] <<- fit

      message(sprintf("%.3f%% of 100%%", round(i / n_outcomes * 100, digits = 3)))

      tibble::tibble(
        sample = sample_label,
        Coef = as.numeric(fit$coef[1]),
        lower = as.numeric(fit$ci[3, 1]),
        upper = as.numeric(fit$ci[3, 2]),
        se = as.numeric(fit$se[3, 1]),
        BW = as.numeric(fit$bws["h", 1]),
        PV = as.numeric(fit$pv[3]),
        intercept = as.numeric(fit$beta_Y_p_l[1]),
        Outcome = outcome_name
      )
    }
  )

  list(
    results = result_list,
    table = comparison_table
  )
}

make_forest_table_by_section <- function(fp_df, first_col_name = "Outcome", indent = TRUE) {
  df.list <- fp_df %>%
    group_by(section) %>%
    group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
    lapply(as.data.frame)

  for (i in seq_along(df.list)) {
    df_i <- df.list[[i]]

    df_i[nrow(df_i) + 1, ] <- c(df_i %>% pull(section) %>% unique(), rep("", ncol(df_i) - 1))
    df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), 1] <- df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), "specification"]
    df_i <- df_i[c(nrow(df_i), 1:(nrow(df_i) - 1)), -ncol(df_i)]

    if (indent) {
      df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1] <- paste0("     ", df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1])
    }

    df_i <- df_i %>%
      mutate(
        coef = as.numeric(coef) * 100,
        lower = as.numeric(lower) * 100,
        upper = as.numeric(upper) * 100,
        coef.r = as.numeric(coef.r) * 100,
        lower.r = as.numeric(lower.r) * 100,
        upper.r = as.numeric(upper.r) * 100,
        pvalue = as.numeric(pvalue),
        pvalue = base::sprintf("%.3f", pvalue),
        pvalue = if_else(pvalue == "0.000", "< 0.001", pvalue),
        se = as.numeric(se),
        bw = floor(as.numeric(bw)),
        `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef, lower, upper)),
        `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef.r, lower.r, upper.r)),
        ` ` = paste(rep(" ", 30), collapse = " ")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)`, `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)`, pvalue, ` `)

    names(df_i)[1] <- first_col_name
    names(df_i)[6] <- "Bandwidth"
    names(df_i)[9] <- "p"

    df_i[1, c(6:10)] <- ""
    df.list[[i]] <- df_i
  }

  df.list
}

save_forestplot_pdf <- function(forestplot_df, path, width, height, xlim = c(-20, 20), ticks_at = c(-20, -10, 0, 10, 20), bg_fill) {
  tm <- forest_theme(
    core = list(bg_params = list(fill = bg_fill)),
    ci_pch = c(15),
    refline_lty = "dotted",
    refline_col = c("#000000"),
    base_size = 10,
    ci_Theight = 0.5,
    ci_col = "black",
    ci_fill = "#67a9cf"
  )

  forestplot_df <- forestplot_df %>%
    mutate(se = 1)

  p <- forest(
    forestplot_df[, c(1, 6:10)],
    est = forestplot_df$coef,
    lower = forestplot_df$lower,
    upper = forestplot_df$upper,
    sizes = forestplot_df$se * 0.5,
    ci_column = 6,
    ref_line = 0,
    xlim = xlim,
    ticks_at = ticks_at,
    xlab = "Absolute effect (% points)",
    theme = tm
  )

  plot(p)
  pdf(path, width = width, height = height)
  print(p)
  dev.off()

  invisible(p)
}
```

# Robustness checks

## Grace periods - shingles

```{r, warning=FALSE}
## Grace periods - shingles ----------------------------------------------------

data_main_zoster <- data_main %>%
  filter(is.na(first_zoster_overall) | first_zoster_overall >= follow_up_beg)

data_main_zoster.female <- data_main_zoster %>%
  filter(GENDER == "F")

data_main_zoster.male <- data_main_zoster %>%
  filter(GENDER == "M")

adjust_follow_up <- function(data, grace_month) {
  data %>%
    mutate(follow_up_beg_grace = follow_up_beg %m+% months(grace_month))
}

perform_rdd_grace <- function(data, grace_month) {
  data_grace <- data %>%
    adjust_follow_up(grace_month) %>%
    filter(is.na(first_zoster_overall) | first_zoster_overall > follow_up_beg_grace)

  rdrobust(
    y          = data_grace$zoster,
    x          = data_grace$running_var_days,
    fuzzy      = data_grace$hz_vacc,
    c          = 0,
    p          = 1,
    scaleregul = 0,
    vce        = "nn",
    bwselect   = "mserd",
    masspoints = "adjust"
  )
}

grace_months <- seq(from = 6, to = 24, by = 6)

results_main <- lapply(grace_months, function(gy) perform_rdd_grace(data_main_zoster, gy))
results_fema <- lapply(grace_months, function(gy) perform_rdd_grace(data_main_zoster.female, gy))
results_male <- lapply(grace_months, function(gy) perform_rdd_grace(data_main_zoster.male, gy))

build_grace_df <- function(results_list, grace_months) {
  purrr::map2_dfr(
    results_list,
    grace_months,
    ~ tibble::tibble(
      V1 = paste(.y, "months"),
      V2 = as.numeric(.x$coef[1, 1]),
      V3 = as.numeric(.x$ci[3, 1]),
      V4 = as.numeric(.x$ci[3, 2]),
      V5 = as.numeric(.x$se[3, 1]),
      V6 = as.numeric(.x$bws[1, 1]),
      V7 = as.numeric(.x$pv[3, 1]),
      V8 = as.numeric(.x$beta_Y_p_l[1]),
      V9 = "Grace period"
    )
  )
}

gpa.df   <- build_grace_df(results_main, grace_months)
gpa.df.f <- build_grace_df(results_fema, grace_months)
gpa.df.m <- build_grace_df(results_male, grace_months)

grace_period_plot_list <- vector("list", 3)
grace_period_plot_list[[1]] <- gpa.df
grace_period_plot_list[[2]] <- gpa.df.f
grace_period_plot_list[[3]] <- gpa.df.m

for (j in seq_along(grace_period_plot_list)) {

  fp.df <- grace_period_plot_list[[j]] %>%
    mutate(
      section = V9,
      coef = as.numeric(V2),
      lower = as.numeric(V3),
      upper = as.numeric(V4),
      se = as.numeric(V5),
      bw = round(as.numeric(V6), digits = 0),
      pvalue = as.numeric(V7),
      intercept_l = as.numeric(V8),
      specification = V1,
      coef.r = coef / intercept_l,
      lower.r = lower / intercept_l,
      upper.r = upper / intercept_l
    ) %>%
    select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, pvalue, coef.r, lower.r, upper.r, specification)

  df.list <- fp.df %>%
    group_by(section) %>%
    group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
    lapply(as.data.frame)

  for (i in seq_along(df.list)) {
    df_i <- df.list[[i]]

    df_i[nrow(df_i) + 1, ] <- c(df_i %>% pull(section) %>% unique(), rep("", ncol(df_i) - 1))
    df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), 1] <- df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), "specification"]
    df_i <- df_i[c(nrow(df_i), 1:(nrow(df_i) - 1)), -ncol(df_i)]
    df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1] <- paste0("     ", df_i[2:nrow(df_i), 1])

    df_i <- df_i %>%
      mutate(
        coef   = as.numeric(coef) * 100,
        lower  = as.numeric(lower) * 100,
        upper  = as.numeric(upper) * 100,
        coef.r = as.numeric(coef.r) * 100,
        lower.r = as.numeric(lower.r) * 100,
        upper.r = as.numeric(upper.r) * 100,
        pvalue = as.numeric(pvalue),
        pvalue = base::sprintf("%.3f", pvalue),
        pvalue = if_else(pvalue == "0.000", "< 0.001", pvalue),
        se     = as.numeric(se),
        bw     = floor(as.numeric(bw)),
        `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef, lower, upper)),
        `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef.r, lower.r, upper.r)),
        ` ` = paste(rep(" ", 30), collapse = " ")
      )

    df_i <- df_i %>%
      dplyr::select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)`, `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)`, pvalue, ` `) %>%
      rename(
        Specification = section,
        Bandwidth = bw,
        p = pvalue
      )

    df_i[1, c(6:10)] <- ""
    df.list[[i]] <- df_i
  }

  grace_period_plot_list[[j]] <- do.call(rbind, df.list)
}

fp.full <- rbind(grace_period_plot_list[[1]][1, ], grace_period_plot_list[[1]])
fp.full[1, 1] <- "Full sample"

fp.fema <- rbind(grace_period_plot_list[[2]][1, ], grace_period_plot_list[[2]])
fp.fema[1, 1] <- "Females"

fp.male <- rbind(grace_period_plot_list[[3]][1, ], grace_period_plot_list[[3]])
fp.male[1, 1] <- "Males"

forest.plot.df_combined <- rbind(fp.full, fp.fema, fp.male)

forest.plot.list.shingles[[2]] <- forest.plot.df_combined
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
# forest.plot.composite.list[[6]] <- do.call(rbind, df.list)

# Kernel robustness checks -----------------------------------------------------
# Epanechnikov kernel weights
rdr_estimation_r1 <- rdrobust(y          = data_main$dementia,
                              x          = data_main$running_var_days,
                              fuzzy      = data_main$hz_vacc,
                              c          = 0,
                              p          = 1,
                              scaleregul = 0,
                              vce        = "nn",
                              bwselect   = "mserd",
                              kernel     = "epa",
                              masspoints = "adjust"
                              )

rdr_estimation_r1.f <- rdrobust(y          = data_main.female$dementia,
                                x          = data_main.female$running_var_days,
                                fuzzy      = data_main.female$hz_vacc,
                                c          = 0,
                                p          = 1,
                                scaleregul = 0,
                                vce        = "nn",
                                bwselect   = "mserd",
                                kernel     = "epa",
                                masspoints = "adjust"
                                )


rdr_estimation_r1.m <- rdrobust(y          = data_main.male$dementia,
                                x          = data_main.male$running_var_days,
                                fuzzy      = data_main.male$hz_vacc,
                                c          = 0,
                                p          = 1,
                                scaleregul = 0,
                                vce        = "nn",
                                bwselect   = "mserd",
                                kernel     = "epa",
                                masspoints = "adjust"
                                )

# Forestplot
rd.result.list <- as.list(1:3)
rd.result.list[[1]] <- rdr_estimation_r1
rd.result.list[[2]] <- rdr_estimation_r1.f
rd.result.list[[3]] <- rdr_estimation_r1.m

fp.df <- as.data.frame(matrix(NA, length(rd.result.list), 9))
specification_name <- c("Full sample", "Females", "Males")

for (i in 1:length(rd.result.list)) {
  fp.df[i,] <- c("Epanechnikov kernel weights", rd.result.list[[i]]$coef[1,1], rd.result.list[[i]]$ci[3,1], rd.result.list[[i]]$ci[3,2], rd.result.list[[i]]$se[3,1], rd.result.list[[i]]$bws[1,1], rd.result.list[[i]]$pv[3,1], rd.result.list[[i]]$beta_Y_p_l[1], specification_name[i])
}

fp.df <- fp.df %>%
  mutate(section = V1,
         coef = as.numeric(V2),
         lower = as.numeric(V3),
         upper = as.numeric(V4),
         se = as.numeric(V5),
         bw = round(as.numeric(V6), digits = 0),
         pvalue = as.numeric(V7),
         intercept_l = as.numeric(V8),
         specification = V9,
         coef.r = as.numeric(V2)/intercept_l,
         lower.r = as.numeric(V3)/intercept_l,
         upper.r = as.numeric(V4)/intercept_l) %>%
  select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, pvalue, coef.r, lower.r, upper.r, specification)

df.list <- fp.df %>%
  group_by(section) %>%
  group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
  lapply(as.data.frame)

for (i in 1:length(df.list)) {

  df.list[[i]][nrow(df.list[[i]])+1,] <- c(df.list[[i]] %>% pull(section) %>% unique(), rep("", ncol(df.list[[i]])-1))
  df.list[[i]][1:nrow(df.list[[i]])-1,1] <- df.list[[i]][1:1:nrow(df.list[[i]])-1,"specification"]
  df.list[[i]] <- df.list[[i]][c(nrow(df.list[[i]]),1:nrow(df.list[[i]])-1),-c(ncol(df.list[[i]]))]
  df.list[[i]][2:nrow(df.list[[i]]),1] <- paste0("     ", df.list[[i]][2:nrow(df.list[[i]]),1])
  df.list[[i]] <- df.list[[i]] %>%
    mutate(coef   = as.numeric(coef)*100,
           lower  = as.numeric(lower)*100,
           upper  =  as.numeric(upper)*100,
           coef.r = as.numeric(coef.r)*100,
           lower.r= as.numeric(lower.r)*100,
           upper.r=  as.numeric(upper.r)*100,
           pvalue = as.numeric(pvalue),
           pvalue = base::sprintf("%.3f", pvalue),
           pvalue = if_else(pvalue == "0.000", "< 0.001",pvalue),
           se     = as.numeric(se),
           bw     = floor(as.numeric(bw)),
           `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "",base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef, lower, upper)),
           `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "",base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef.r, lower.r, upper.r)),
           ` ` = paste(rep(" ", 30), collapse = " ")
    )

  df.list[[i]] <- df.list[[i]] %>% dplyr::select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)`, `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)`, pvalue, ` `) %>%
    rename("Specification" = section,
           Bandwidth = bw,
           p = pvalue)

  df.list[[i]][1,c(6:10)] <- ""

}
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
## Placebo index dates ---------------------------------------------------------

adjust_index_date <- function(data, placebo_shift) {
  data %>%
    mutate(cutoff_date_placebo = cutoff_date %m+% months(placebo_shift))
}

perform_rdd_placebo_shift <- function(data, placebo_shift) {
  data_ps <- data %>%
    adjust_index_date(placebo_shift) %>%
    mutate(
      running_var_days_placebo = as.numeric(difftime(DOB, cutoff_date_placebo, units = "days"))
    )

  rdrobust(
    y          = data_ps$dementia,
    x          = data_ps$running_var_days_placebo,
    c          = 0,
    p          = 1,
    scaleregul = 0,
    vce        = "nn",
    bwselect   = "mserd",
    masspoints = "adjust"
  )
}

placebo_shifts <- c(seq(from = -12, to = -2, by = 2), seq(from = 2, to = 12, by = 2))

sample_list <- list(
  "Full sample" = data_main,
  "Females"     = data_main.female,
  "Males"       = data_main.male
)

results_by_sample <- lapply(sample_list, function(dat) {
  lapply(placebo_shifts, function(ps) perform_rdd_placebo_shift(dat, ps))
})

build_placebo_df <- function(results_list, placebo_shifts, sample_name) {
  purrr::map2_dfr(
    results_list,
    placebo_shifts,
    ~ tibble::tibble(
      V1 = .y,
      V2 = as.numeric(.x$coef[1, 1]),
      V3 = as.numeric(.x$ci[3, 1]),
      V4 = as.numeric(.x$ci[3, 2]),
      V5 = as.numeric(.x$se[3, 1]),
      V6 = as.numeric(.x$bws[1, 1]),
      V7 = as.numeric(.x$pv[3, 1]),
      V8 = as.numeric(.x$beta_Y_p_l[1]),
      V9 = sample_name
    )
  )
}

psa.df   <- build_placebo_df(results_by_sample[["Full sample"]], placebo_shifts, "Full sample")
psa.df.f <- build_placebo_df(results_by_sample[["Females"]], placebo_shifts, "Females")
psa.df.m <- build_placebo_df(results_by_sample[["Males"]], placebo_shifts, "Males")

fp.df <- bind_rows(psa.df, psa.df.f, psa.df.m) %>%
  mutate(
    section = V9,
    coef = as.numeric(V2),
    lower = as.numeric(V3),
    upper = as.numeric(V4),
    se = as.numeric(V5),
    bw = round(as.numeric(V6), digits = 0),
    pvalue = as.numeric(V7),
    intercept_l = as.numeric(V8),
    specification = V1,
    coef.r = coef / intercept_l,
    lower.r = lower / intercept_l,
    upper.r = upper / intercept_l
  ) %>%
  select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, pvalue, coef.r, lower.r, upper.r, specification)

df.list <- fp.df %>%
  group_by(section) %>%
  group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
  lapply(as.data.frame)

for (i in seq_along(df.list)) {
  df_i <- df.list[[i]]

  df_i[nrow(df_i) + 1, ] <- c(df_i %>% pull(section) %>% unique(), rep("", ncol(df_i) - 1))
  df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), 1] <- df_i[1:(nrow(df_i) - 1), "specification"]
  df_i <- df_i[c(nrow(df_i), 1:(nrow(df_i) - 1)), -ncol(df_i)]

  df_i <- df_i %>%
    mutate(
      coef   = as.numeric(coef) * 100,
      lower  = as.numeric(lower) * 100,
      upper  = as.numeric(upper) * 100,
      coef.r = as.numeric(coef.r) * 100,
      lower.r = as.numeric(lower.r) * 100,
      upper.r = as.numeric(upper.r) * 100,
      pvalue = as.numeric(pvalue),
      pvalue = base::sprintf("%.3f", pvalue),
      pvalue = if_else(pvalue == "0.000", "< 0.001", pvalue),
      se     = as.numeric(se),
      bw     = floor(as.numeric(bw)),
      `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef, lower, upper)),
      `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(se), "", base::sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", coef.r, lower.r, upper.r)),
      ` ` = paste(rep(" ", 30), collapse = " ")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(section, coef, lower, upper, se, bw, `Abs. effect coef. (95% CI)`, `Rel. effect coef. (95% CI)`, pvalue, ` `) %>%
    rename(
      `Shift of DOB threshold (months)` = section,
      Bandwidth = bw,
      p = pvalue
    )

  df_i[1, c(6:10)] <- ""
  df.list[[i]] <- df_i
}

forestplot.df <- bind_rows(df.list[[2]], df.list[[1]], df.list[[3]])

tm_combined <- forest_theme(

extract_sample_rows <- function(fp_table, sample_label) {
  header_idx <- which(fp_table[[1]] == sample_label)
  if (length(header_idx) != 1) {

  fp_table[header_idx:(header_idx + length(placebo_shifts)), , drop = FALSE]
}
```

## RDD plot for dementia risk at baseline

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# Dementia risk at baseline ----------------------------------------------------

bw <- rdr_estimation_nc$bws["h", 1]

risk_vars <- c(
  "hypertension_drug_1yp", "alcohol_at_bl", "dm_at_bl", "depression_1yp",
  "stroke_at_bl", "atf_at_bl", "aspirin_1yp", "statins_1yp", "NSAID_1yp"
)

X <- data_main %>%
  mutate(
    riskcount_abs = rowSums(across(all_of(risk_vars)), na.rm = TRUE),
    riskcount_rel = riskcount_abs / length(risk_vars) * 100
  )

sample_dfs <- list(
  full   = X,
  female = X %>% filter(GENDER == "F"),
  male   = X %>% filter(GENDER == "M")
)

facet_labels <- c(
  "full"   = "Full sample",
  "female" = "Female sample",
  "male"   = "Male sample"
)

# Fixed settings
bin_size <- 365 / 3
limit <- 365 * 7

fit_rd_risk <- function(df, h_val) {
  rdrobust(
    y          = as.numeric(df$riskcount_rel),
    x          = df$running_var_days,
    c          = 0,
    scaleregul = 1,
    p          = 1,
    h          = h_val,
    vce        = "nn",
    kernel     = "triangular",
    masspoints = "adjust"
  )
}

prepare_risk_plot_data <- function(df, rd_fit, sample_name, bin_size, limit) {
  bw_local <- rd_fit$bws["h", 1]

  data_plot <- df %>%
    mutate(
      running_var_bin = cut(
        running_var_days,
        breaks = seq(-limit, limit, by = bin_size),
        include.lowest = TRUE,
        right = FALSE,
        labels = FALSE
      ),
      eligible = as.numeric(running_var_days >= 0),
      tria_weights = pmax(0, 1 - abs(running_var_days) / abs(bw_local))
    ) %>%
    group_by(running_var_bin, eligible) %>%
    summarise(
      pc1_z_binned = mean(riskcount_rel, na.rm = TRUE),
      tria_weights_binned = mean(tria_weights, na.rm = TRUE),
      running_var_days = mean(running_var_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(running_var_days >= -limit, running_var_days <= limit)

  bin_zero <- data_plot %>%
    filter(running_var_days == min(abs(running_var_days), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(abs(running_var_days)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(running_var_bin)

  if (length(bin_zero) == 0 || is.na(bin_zero)) {
    bin_zero <- which.min(abs(seq(-limit, limit - bin_size, by = bin_size))) + 1
  }

  data_plot <- data_plot %>%
    mutate(
      eligible = factor(eligible),
      running_var_bin = as.numeric((running_var_bin - bin_zero) * bin_size),
      sample = sample_name
    ) %>%
    select(sample, running_var_bin, pc1_z_binned, eligible, tria_weights_binned)

  data_lines <- tibble(
    running_var_days = seq(min(df$running_var_days, na.rm = TRUE), max(df$running_var_days, na.rm = TRUE), by = 1)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      y_outcome_right = rd_fit$beta_Y_p_r[1] + running_var_days * rd_fit$beta_Y_p_r[2],
      y_outcome_left  = rd_fit$beta_Y_p_l[1] + running_var_days * rd_fit$beta_Y_p_l[2],
      eligible = as.numeric(running_var_days >= 0),
      inside_bandwidth = ifelse(running_var_days >= -bw_local & running_var_days <= bw_local, 1, 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(inside_bandwidth == 1) %>%
    transmute(
      sample = sample_name,
      running_var_days,
      y_outcome = ifelse(eligible == 1, y_outcome_right, y_outcome_left),
      eligible = factor(eligible)
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  ann_df <- tibble(
    sample = sample_name,
    label = paste0(
      "Coef. = ", round(rd_fit$coef[1, 1], digits = 1),
      "\n(95% CI: ", round(rd_fit$ci[3, 1], digits = 1),
      " to ", round(rd_fit$ci[3, 2], digits = 1), ")",
      "\np = ", sprintf("%.3f", rd_fit$pv[3])
    ),
    x = -4 * 365,
    y = Inf
  )

  bw_df <- tibble(
    sample = sample_name,
    bw_start_date = -1 * bw_local,
    bw_end_date = bw_local
  )

  list(
    data_plot = data_plot,
    data_lines = data_lines,
    ann_df = ann_df,
    bw_df = bw_df
  )
}

# Fit RD models
rd_pc1   <- fit_rd_risk(sample_dfs$full, bw)
rd_pc1.f <- fit_rd_risk(sample_dfs$female, bw)
rd_pc1.m <- fit_rd_risk(sample_dfs$male, bw)

# Build plotting data
plot_objs <- list(
  full   = prepare_risk_plot_data(sample_dfs$full, rd_pc1, "full", bin_size, limit),
  female = prepare_risk_plot_data(sample_dfs$female, rd_pc1.f, "female", bin_size, limit),
  male   = prepare_risk_plot_data(sample_dfs$male, rd_pc1.m, "male", bin_size, limit)
)

data_plot_fw <- bind_rows(lapply(plot_objs, `[[`, "data_plot")) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = c("full", "female", "male")))

data_lines_df <- bind_rows(lapply(plot_objs, `[[`, "data_lines")) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = c("full", "female", "male")))

ann_df <- bind_rows(lapply(plot_objs, `[[`, "ann_df")) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = c("full", "female", "male")))

bw_df <- bind_rows(lapply(plot_objs, `[[`, "bw_df")) %>%
  mutate(sample = factor(sample, levels = c("full", "female", "male")))

combined_plot_fw_risk <- data_plot_fw %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = running_var_bin, y = pc1_z_binned, group = eligible)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = bw_df,
    aes(
      xmin = bw_start_date,
      xmax = bw_end_date,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf
    ),
    fill = "gray",
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = ann_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = 1.10,
    size = 3,
    fill = "white",
    label.r = unit(0, "lines"),
    label.size = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(alpha = tria_weights_binned, col = eligible, size = tria_weights_binned)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 3)) +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.1, 0.9)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#D81B60", "#1E88E5")) +
  geom_line(
    data = data_lines_df,
    aes(x = running_var_days, y = y_outcome, group = eligible),
    color = "black",
    lty = "solid",
    lwd = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, lty = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(from = -365 * 6, to = 365 * 6, by = 2 * 365)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(10, 40)) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of days from April 2, 1937",
    y = "Baseline risk factor burden (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 1.1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.line = element_line(),
    axis.ticks = element_line()
  ) +
  guides(color = FALSE, size = FALSE, alpha = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~sample, labeller = as_labeller(facet_labels))

# Manuscript reference: Figure S6.
combined_plot_fw_risk

ggsave(
  file.path(table_dir, "plot_dementia_baseline_risk_fw.pdf"),
  plot = combined_plot_fw_risk,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  units = "in"
)
```
