# Survival analysis

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# Survival analysis

# Study-wide settings
band_days <- 365
end_date  <- as.Date("2023-06-30")

a0     <- 80.00
a_star <- 84.25
time_grid <- seq(a0, a_star, by = 1/12)

cols <- c(
  "Ineligible" = "#D81B60",
  "Eligible"   = "#1E88E5"
)

age_in_years <- function(date, DOB) {
  as.numeric(difftime(date, DOB, units = "days")) / 365.25
}

# Prepare base survival data ONCE
data_mort_base <- data %>%
  rename(DOD_old = DOD) %>%
  full_join(moscoded_flagged) %>%
  filter(DOB >= follow_up_beg - years(95)) %>%
  mutate(birthday_80 = DOB + years(80)) %>%
  filter(is.na(first_dementia_overall) | first_dementia_overall >= birthday_80) %>%
  mutate(
    DOD = as.Date(DOD, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    DOD_comb = pmax(DOD_old, DOD, na.rm = TRUE),
    censoring_date = as.Date("2023-06-30"),
    DOD_comb_2 = if_else(!is.na(DOD_comb) & DOD_comb >= censoring_date, NA_Date_, DOD_comb),
    DOD = DOD_comb_2,
    death_by_dementia_date = if_else(
      !is.na(dementia_narrow_def_flag) & dementia_narrow_def_flag == 1,
      DOD,
      NA_Date_
    ),
    first_dementia_overall = pmin(first_dementia_overall, death_by_dementia_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    T_death    = as.numeric(difftime(DOD, follow_up_beg, units = "days")),
    T_dementia = as.numeric(difftime(first_dementia_overall, follow_up_beg, units = "days")),
    horizon    = as.numeric(difftime(censoring_date, follow_up_beg, units = "days")),
    T_obs      = pmin(T_death, T_dementia, horizon, na.rm = TRUE),
    delta = if_else(
      !is.na(T_dementia) &
        (is.na(T_death) | T_dementia <= T_death) &
        T_dementia <= horizon,
      1L, 0L
    ),
    censored = 1L - delta,
    censor_type = case_when(
      !is.na(T_dementia) &
        (is.na(T_death) | T_dementia <= T_death) &
        T_dementia <= horizon ~ 0L,
      !is.na(T_death) &
        (is.na(T_dementia) | T_death < T_dementia) &
        T_death <= horizon ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ 1L
    ),
    censored_by_death = as.integer(censor_type == 2L),
    censored_by_horiz = as.integer(censor_type == 1L),
    eligibility = as.integer(running_var_days >= 0)
  )

build_survival_plots <- function(data_mort_base, gender_filter = NULL, include_event_free = FALSE) {

  df0 <- data_mort_base
  if (!is.null(gender_filter)) {
    df0 <- df0 %>% filter(GENDER == gender_filter)
  }

  df_rd <- df0 %>%
    mutate(in_bw = abs(running_var_days) <= band_days) %>%
    filter(in_bw)

  df_surv <- df_rd %>%
    mutate(
      first_event_date = pmin(
        coalesce(first_dementia_overall, as.Date(Inf)),
        coalesce(DOD, as.Date(Inf)),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      admin_censor_date = end_date,
      date_reach_a_star = DOB %m+% years(84) %m+% months(3),
      exit_date_raw = pmin(first_event_date, admin_censor_date, date_reach_a_star, na.rm = TRUE),
      age_entry = 80,
      age_exit  = age_in_years(exit_date_raw, DOB),
      cause = case_when(
        !is.na(first_dementia_overall) & first_dementia_overall == exit_date_raw ~ 1L,
        !is.na(DOD) & DOD == exit_date_raw ~ 2L,
        TRUE ~ 0L
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(age_exit > a0, age_entry < a_star) %>%
    filter(age_exit > age_entry) %>%
    mutate(
      age_entry = pmax(age_entry, a0),
      age_exit  = pmin(age_exit, a_star)
    ) %>%
    filter(is.na(first_dementia_overall) | first_dementia_overall > birthday_80)

  fit_both <- prodlim(
    Hist(time = age_exit, event = cause, entry = age_entry) ~ factor(eligibility),
    data = df_surv,
    conf.int = 0.95
  )

  df_cs <- df_surv %>%
    mutate(event_dementia = as.integer(cause == 1))

  fit_cs <- prodlim(
    Hist(time = age_exit, event = event_dementia, entry = age_entry) ~ factor(eligibility),
    data = df_cs,
    conf.int = 0.95
  )

  cs_wide <- as.data.frame(fit_cs, times = time_grid)

  p4 <- cs_wide %>%
    mutate(
      eligible = factor(eligibility, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Ineligible", "Eligible")),
      surv = surv * 100,
      lower = lower * 100,
      upper = upper * 100
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = surv, color = eligible, fill = eligible, lty = eligible)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.20, linewidth = 0) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(80, 84.25),
      breaks = seq(80, 84.25, by = 6/12)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(90, 100),
      labels = label_percent(scale = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Age",
      y = "Cause-specific survival (dementia)",
      color = NULL, fill = NULL, lty = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 1.1),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.line = element_line(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  plot_list <- list(p4 = p4)

  if (include_event_free) {
    cif1 <- as.data.frame(fit_both, times = time_grid, cause = 1) %>%
      mutate(cause = 1)

    cif2 <- as.data.frame(fit_both, times = time_grid, cause = 2) %>%
      mutate(cause = 2)

    surv_df <- bind_rows(cif1, cif2) %>%
      mutate(
        eligible = factor(eligibility, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Ineligible", "Eligible"))
      ) %>%
      select(time, eligible, cause, absolute_risk, lower, upper) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = cause,
        values_from = c(absolute_risk, lower, upper),
        names_sep = "_c"
      ) %>%
      transmute(
        time,
        eligible,
        surv  = 1 - (absolute_risk_c1 + absolute_risk_c2),
        lower = 1 - (upper_c1 + upper_c2),
        upper = 1 - (lower_c1 + lower_c2),
        surv  = pmax(pmin(surv, 1), 0),
        lower = pmax(pmin(lower, 1), 0),
        upper = pmax(pmin(upper, 1), 0)
      )

    plot_list$p5 <- surv_df %>%
      mutate(
        surv = surv * 100,
        lower = lower * 100,
        upper = upper * 100
      ) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = time, y = surv, color = eligible, fill = eligible, lty = eligible)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.20, linewidth = 0) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(80, 84.25),
        breaks = seq(80, 84.25, by = 6/12)
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(75, 100),
        labels = label_percent(scale = 1)
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "Age",
        y = "Event-free survival",
        color = NULL, fill = NULL, lty = NULL
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 1.1),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.line = element_line(),
        axis.ticks = element_line(),
        legend.position = "top"
      )
  }

  plot_list
}

# Run once per sample
surv_plots_full <- build_survival_plots(data_mort_base, gender_filter = NULL, include_event_free = TRUE)
surv_plots_f    <- build_survival_plots(data_mort_base, gender_filter = "F")
surv_plots_m    <- build_survival_plots(data_mort_base, gender_filter = "M")

# Print figures included in the manuscript and supplement.
p4 <- surv_plots_full$p4
p5 <- surv_plots_full$p5
p4_f <- surv_plots_f$p4
p4_m <- surv_plots_m$p4

# Manuscript reference: Figure S13.
print(p4)
# Manuscript reference: event-free survival companion to Figure S13.
print(p5)
# Manuscript reference: Figure S14.
print(p4_f)
# Manuscript reference: Figure S15.
print(p4_m)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(table_dir, "survival_p4.pdf"),
  plot = p4,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(table_dir, "survival_p5.pdf"),
  plot = p5,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(table_dir, "survival_p4_f.pdf"),
  plot = p4_f,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(table_dir, "survival_p4_m.pdf"),
  plot = p4_m,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  units = "in"
)
```

# Difference-in-differences estimator - dementia

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Difference-in-differences estimator - dementia

start_age_years  <- 75
start_age_months <- 9
end_age_years    <- 84
end_age_months   <- 3

follow_up_end <- as.Date("2023-06-30")
denominator   <- 12  # monthly bins

age_grid_years <- seq(
  from = start_age_years + start_age_months / 12,
  to   = end_age_years   + end_age_months   / 12,
  by   = 1 / denominator
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Construct RD-restricted person-level DiD sample
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

data_did <- data %>%
  mutate(
    DOD = as.Date(DOD, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
    eligible = as.integer(running_var_days >= 0),
    id = new_enc_nhi,
    baseline_date = DOB %m+% years(start_age_years) %m+% months(start_age_months),
    horizon_date  = DOB %m+% years(end_age_years)   %m+% months(end_age_months)
  ) %>%
  filter(between(running_var_days, -365, 365)) %>%
  filter(is.na(DOD) | DOD >= baseline_date) %>%
  filter(is.na(first_dementia_overall) | first_dementia_overall >= baseline_date) %>%
  select(
    id, DOB, GENDER, eligible, baseline_date, horizon_date,
    DOD, first_dementia_overall
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Expand to person-age panel much faster than rowwise() %>% do()
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

age_grid_df <- tibble(age_years = age_grid_years) %>%
  mutate(
    whole_years = floor(age_years),
    add_months  = round((age_years - whole_years) * 12)
  )

data_panel <- data_did %>%
  tidyr::crossing(age_grid_df) %>%
  mutate(
    age_date = DOB %m+% years(whole_years) %m+% months(add_months),
    stop_date = pmin(
      horizon_date,
      follow_up_end,
      coalesce(DOD, follow_up_end),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    keep = age_date >= baseline_date & age_date <= stop_date,
    Y_dementia = if_else(
      !is.na(first_dementia_overall) & first_dementia_overall <= age_date,
      1L, 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(keep) %>%
  mutate(
    age_month_index = as.integer(round(age_years * denominator)),
    rel_mon = age_month_index - 80 * denominator,
    post = as.integer(rel_mon >= 0),
    treat_post = eligible * post
  ) %>%
  select(id, DOB, GENDER, eligible, age_years, age_month_index, age_date, rel_mon, post, treat_post, Y_dementia)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. TWFE DiD
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

did_fit <- feols(
  Y_dementia ~ treat_post | id + age_month_index,
  data = data_panel,
  cluster = ~id
)

summary(did_fit)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Event-study models
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

es <- feols(
  Y_dementia ~ i(rel_mon, eligible, ref = -1) | id + rel_mon,
  cluster = ~id,
  data = data_panel
)

es.f <- feols(
  Y_dementia ~ i(rel_mon, eligible, ref = -1) | id + rel_mon,
  cluster = ~id,
  data = filter(data_panel, GENDER == "F")
)

es.m <- feols(
  Y_dementia ~ i(rel_mon, eligible, ref = -1) | id + rel_mon,
  cluster = ~id,
  data = filter(data_panel, GENDER == "M")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Helper for ggplot event-study figures
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

make_es_plot <- function(d, facet_var = NULL) {
  p <- d %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = estimate)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 1, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high, color = sig)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-60, 60), breaks = seq(-60, 60, by = 10)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "black")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(suffix = " pp")) +
    labs(
      x = "Age (months) relative to age 80",
      y = "ITT effect on cumulative dementia diagnoses",
      color = "95% CI excludes 0"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = 1.1),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.line  = element_line(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "top"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = 14, xend = 0.2,
      y = Inf, yend = Inf,
      vjust = 2,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.18, "cm"), type = "closed"),
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    annotate(
      "label",
      x = 22, y = Inf,
      label = "Start of eligibility",
      hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
      size = 4,
      label.size = 0.25,
      label.r = unit(0, "lines")
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

  if (!is.null(facet_var)) {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(stats::as.formula(paste("~", facet_var)), nrow = 2)
  }

  p
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Full sample ggplot event-study
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

d <- ggfixest::iplot_data(es, .ci_level = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = if_else((ci_low > 0) | (ci_high < 0), "Yes", "No"),
    estimate = estimate * 100,
    ci_low = ci_low * 100,
    ci_high = ci_high * 100
  )

p2 <- make_es_plot(d)

ggsave(
  file.path(table_dir, "did_p2_full.pdf"),
  plot = p2,
  width = 10,
  height = 4,
  units = "in"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Female and male sample event-study data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

d.f <- ggfixest::iplot_data(es.f, .ci_level = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = if_else((ci_low > 0) | (ci_high < 0), "Yes", "No"),
    estimate = estimate * 100,
    ci_low = ci_low * 100,
    ci_high = ci_high * 100
  )

d.m <- ggfixest::iplot_data(es.m, .ci_level = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = if_else((ci_low > 0) | (ci_high < 0), "Yes", "No"),
    estimate = estimate * 100,
    ci_low = ci_low * 100,
    ci_high = ci_high * 100
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Female + male combined faceted plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

d.fm <- bind_rows(
  d.f %>% mutate(GENDER = "Females"),
  d.m %>% mutate(GENDER = "Males")
)

p5 <- make_es_plot(d.fm, facet_var = "GENDER")

ggsave(
  file.path(table_dir, "did_p5_fema_male_comb.pdf"),
  plot = p5,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  units = "in"
)

# Manuscript reference: Figure 5.
print(p2)
# Manuscript reference: Figure S12.
print(p5)
```

# Heterogeneity analyses using rdhte package

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Heterogeneity-prep variables (partially for bootstrap in second script)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

dep18_median_main  <- median(data_main$Dep18, na.rm = TRUE)
risk_median_main   <- data_main %>%
  mutate(riskcount_abs_tmp = rowSums(across(all_of(risk_vars)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(riskcount_abs_tmp) %>%
  median(na.rm = TRUE)

dep18_median_main_p <- median(data_main_p$Dep18, na.rm = TRUE)
risk_median_main_p  <- data_main_p %>%
  mutate(riskcount_abs_tmp = rowSums(across(all_of(risk_vars)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(riskcount_abs_tmp) %>%
  median(na.rm = TRUE)

data_main <- data_main %>%
  mutate(
    dep_median = as.integer(Dep18 > dep18_median_main),
    riskcount_abs = rowSums(across(all_of(risk_vars)), na.rm = TRUE),
    risk_median = as.integer(riskcount_abs > risk_median_main),
    grace_36m_date = follow_up_beg %m+% months(36),
    dementia_36m_grace = if_else(
      dementia == 1 & first_dementia_overall >= grace_36m_date,
      1L, 0L
    ),
    maori_pasifika = as.integer(
      ethnicity_factor %in% c("Maori", "Pacific Peoples")
    ),
    zoster_at_bl = as.integer(
      zoster == 1 & first_zoster_overall <= follow_up_beg
    )
  )

data_main_p <- data_main_p %>%
  mutate(
    dep_median = as.integer(Dep18 > dep18_median_main_p),
    riskcount_abs = rowSums(across(all_of(risk_vars)), na.rm = TRUE),
    risk_median = as.integer(riskcount_abs > risk_median_main_p),
    maori_pasifika = as.factor(as.integer(
      ethnicity_factor %in% c("Maori", "Pacific Peoples")
    )),
    zoster_at_bl = as.factor(as.integer(
      zoster == 1 & first_zoster_overall <= follow_up_beg
    )),
    stroke_at_bl_factor = as.factor(stroke_at_bl),
    hypertension_at_bl_factor = as.factor(hypertension_at_bl),
    dm_at_bl_factor = as.factor(dm_at_bl),
    atf_at_bl_factor = as.factor(atf_at_bl)
  )

data_main_p.female <- data_main_p %>%
  filter(GENDER == "F")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Heterogeneity tests with rdhte
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Zoster outcome by gender
r1 <- rdhte(
  x = data_main_zoster$running_var_days,
  y = data_main_zoster$zoster,
  c = 0,
  covs.hte = data_main_zoster$GENDER,
  bwselect = "mserd",
  kernel = "triangular",
  p = 1,
  q = 2
)

linfct_1 <- c("`data_main_zoster$GENDERF` - `data_main_zoster$GENDERM` = 0")
rl1 <- rdhte_lincom(r1, linfct = linfct_1)

rl1

# Dementia outcome by gender
r2 <- rdhte(
  x = data_main$running_var_days,
  y = data_main$dementia,
  c = 0,
  covs.hte = data_main$GENDER,
  bwselect = "mserd",
  kernel = "triangular",
  p = 1,
  q = 2
)

linfct_2 <- c("`data_main$GENDERF` - `data_main$GENDERM` = 0")
rl2 <- rdhte_lincom(r2, linfct = linfct_2)

rl2
```

```{r}
    PPV23_at_bl = factor(PPV23_at_bl, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    influenza_vacc_at_bl = factor(influenza_vacc_at_bl, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl = as.numeric(influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl),
    age_at_follow_up_beg = as.numeric(difftime(follow_up_beg, DOB, units = "days")/365.25),
    eligible = factor(as.integer(running_var_days >= 0), levels = c(0,1),
                      labels = c("Not eligible","Eligible")),
    inside_bandwidth = factor(
      ifelse(running_var_days >= -bw & running_var_days <= bw, 1, 0),
      levels = c(0,1),
      labels = c("Outside MSE-optimal bandwidth","Within MSE-optimal bandwidth")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    GENDER, hz_vacc_at_bl, dementia_at_bl, ethnicity_factor, deprivation_index_factor,
    hypertension_drug_1yp, alcohol_at_bl, dm_at_bl,
    depression_1yp, stroke_at_bl, atf_at_bl, NSAID_1yp, aspirin_1yp, statins_1yp,
    PCV13_at_bl, PPV23_at_bl, influenza_vacc_at_bl, influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl,
    age_at_follow_up_beg, eligible, inside_bandwidth
  )

table1::label(data_descript$hz_vacc_at_bl)            <- "Herpes Zoster vaccinationᵃ"
table1::label(data_descript$dementia_at_bl)           <- "Dementiaᵃ"
table1::label(data_descript$ethnicity_factor)         <- "Ethnicity"

table1::label(data_descript$depression_1yp)           <- "Depressionᵇ"
table1::label(data_descript$stroke_at_bl)             <- "Stroke, transient ischemic attackᵃ"

table1::label(data_descript$influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl)     <- "Influenza vaccination (counts)ᵃ"
attr(data_descript$influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl, "units")     <- "counts"
table1::label(data_descript$age_at_follow_up_beg)     <- "Age in years at program start"
table1::label(data_descript$eligible)                 <- "Ever eligible to program"
attr(data_descript$age_at_follow_up_beg, "units")     <- "years"

footnote_1 <- "ᵃEver diagnosed/received at baseline, ᵇIn year prior to program start, ᶜEver diagnosed/received at endline"
caption_1  <- "Descriptive statistics"

add_missing_level <- function(x) {
  if (!is.factor(x)) x <- factor(x)
  if (!("Missing" %in% levels(x))) levels(x) <- c(levels(x), "Missing")
  x[is.na(x)] <- "Missing"
  x
}
cat_vars <- c("hz_vacc_at_bl","dementia_at_bl","ethnicity_factor","deprivation_index_factor",
              "hypertension_drug_1yp","alcohol_at_bl","dm_at_bl","depression_1yp",
              "stroke_at_bl","atf_at_bl","NSAID_1yp","aspirin_1yp","statins_1yp",
              "PCV13_at_bl", "PPV23_at_bl", "influenza_vacc_at_bl",
              "eligible")
data_descript <- data_descript %>% mutate(across(all_of(cat_vars), add_missing_level))
ref_levels <- lapply(data_descript[cat_vars], levels)
coerce_levels <- function(df, ref_levels) {
  for (nm in names(ref_levels)) if (nm %in% names(df) && is.factor(df[[nm]]))
    df[[nm]] <- factor(df[[nm]], levels = ref_levels[[nm]])
  df
}

wbw <- data_descript %>%
  filter(inside_bandwidth == "Within MSE-optimal bandwidth") %>%
  coerce_levels(ref_levels)

ws  <- data_descript %>%
  coerce_levels(ref_levels)

strata <- c(
  list("Within MSE-BW — Male"    = wbw %>% filter(GENDER == "Male")   %>% coerce_levels(ref_levels)),
  list("Within MSE-BW — Female"  = wbw %>% filter(GENDER == "Female") %>% coerce_levels(ref_levels)),
  list("Within MSE-BW — Overall" = wbw),
  list("Whole sample — Male"     = ws  %>% filter(GENDER == "Male")   %>% coerce_levels(ref_levels)),
  list("Whole sample — Female"   = ws  %>% filter(GENDER == "Female") %>% coerce_levels(ref_levels)),
  list("Whole sample — Overall"  = ws)
)

labels <- list(
  variables = list(
    age_at_follow_up_beg       = render.varlabel(data_descript$age_at_follow_up_beg),
    hz_vacc_at_bl              = render.varlabel(data_descript$hz_vacc_at_bl),
    dementia_at_bl             = render.varlabel(data_descript$dementia_at_bl),
    ethnicity_factor           = render.varlabel(data_descript$ethnicity_factor),
    deprivation_index_factor   = render.varlabel(data_descript$deprivation_index_factor),
    hypertension_drug_1yp      = render.varlabel(data_descript$hypertension_drug_1yp),
    alcohol_at_bl              = render.varlabel(data_descript$alcohol_at_bl),
    dm_at_bl                   = render.varlabel(data_descript$dm_at_bl),
    depression_1yp             = render.varlabel(data_descript$depression_1yp),
    stroke_at_bl               = render.varlabel(data_descript$stroke_at_bl),
    atf_at_bl                  = render.varlabel(data_descript$atf_at_bl),
    NSAID_1yp                  = render.varlabel(data_descript$NSAID_1yp),
    aspirin_1yp                = render.varlabel(data_descript$aspirin_1yp),
    statins_1yp                = render.varlabel(data_descript$statins_1yp),
    PCV13_at_bl                = render.varlabel(data_descript$PCV13_at_bl),
    PPV23_at_bl                = render.varlabel(data_descript$PPV23_at_bl),
    influenza_vacc_at_bl       = render.varlabel(data_descript$influenza_vacc_at_bl),
    influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl = render.varlabel(data_descript$influenza_vacc_counts_at_bl),
    eligible                   = render.varlabel(data_descript$eligible)
  ),
  groups = list("Within MSE-BW", "Whole sample")
)

descriptives_table <- table1(
  strata,
  labels,
  groupspan = c(3, 3),
  footnote  = footnote_1,
  caption   = caption_1
)

sect_properties <- prop_section(
  page_size(width = 12, height = 22, orient = "portrait"),
  type = "continuous",
  page_margins = page_mar()
)

table1::t1flex(descriptives_table) %>%
  flextable::save_as_docx(
    path = file.path(table_dir, "descriptives_table_dec_25.docx"),
    pr_section = sect_properties
  )

descriptives_table
```
